diagnosis: The customer is on legacy_auth and needs to reset their API token. The provided KB article kb-0002 contains the exact steps for this scenario. No escalation is required as the solution is documented and the account tier supports standard self-service.
reply:
Hello,

To reset your API token on your Legacy Auth account, please open the Security tab in your dashboard and choose "Reset token". Please note that your previous API token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset to allow for a smooth transition.

For more details, you can refer to our guide: Reset an API token on Legacy Auth accounts.

Best regards,
Support Team
